# Required check manifest for vizra-search (ADR-002 § CI fan-in and merge queue).
#
# `ci-required` reads this file and fails unless every listed job concluded
# `success`. Anything else — failure, cancellation, timeout, skip, never-ran —
# fails the aggregate, so a lane that silently stops running blocks the merge
# instead of disappearing.
#
# One job name per line. Blank lines and # comments are ignored.
# This file is owner-reviewed (CODEOWNERS): it must not be edited in the same
# PR as the code it guards.
#
# A PR may ADD a lane here. It may not REMOVE one of the floor lanes — build,
# test, test-noskip, contract-drift, govulncheck, vendor-contract-selftest —
# because this manifest is read from the checkout under test, so a PR could
# otherwise stop gating itself by deleting a line. The floor lives in
# scripts/ci-required-guard.py (FLOOR_LANES), not here.
# Entries must be bare job names: no trailing comment, no "optional" marker.

fmt
vet
echo-containment
build
contract-drift
test
test-noskip
tidy-check
govulncheck
vendor-contract-selftest
docker-build
